enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Turn to left side. Open eyes at 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands and face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Dry face with towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making toast, and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Take mug. Pour water. Butter toast. Eat breakfast. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Turning on the desk lamp and setting up the computer for the work-from-home day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Walk to desk. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on chair. Open computer lid. Press power button. Enter password. Adjust chair. Open work applications.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing email and planning the day's community program schedule on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open email client. Scroll through inbox. Open first email. Read. Click reply. Type response. Send. Open second email. Read. Mark as read. Open calendar. Click on date. Add event. Open planning doc. Type schedule. Save.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: drafting grant reports and coordinating community program logistics on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open grant report template. Type title. Type introduction. Type body paragraphs. Check word count. Save file. Open logistics spreadsheet. Update contact list. Send email to partners. Make phone call. Take notes. Open budget file. Enter figures. Save. Open presentation. Add slides. Save. Close files.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating up and eating lunch, then clearing the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out lunch container. Open microwave. Place container inside. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Open microwave. Take out container. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up dishes. Scrape food into bin. Load dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood for fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Open door. Step outside. Walk down sidewalk. Turn right. Walk around block. Turn back. Walk back. Open door. Enter. Remove shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Working: joining video calls with partner organizations and updating program calendars on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video call app. Join meeting. Adjust camera. Unmute. Speak. Mute. Take notes. Leave meeting. Open calendar. Update events. Send invites. Join second call. Adjust volume. Speak. Leave call. Update calendar. Save.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and taking a short break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Take mug. Put tea bag. Pour boiled water. Add milk. Stir. Sit at table. Drink tea. Stand up. Rinse mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Working: answering emails and finalizing volunteer rosters on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open email client. Read new emails. Reply to email. Archive email. Open volunteer roster spreadsheet. Update names. Check availability. Send email to volunteers. Save spreadsheet. Open second email. Reply. Send. Close email. Open roster again. Finalize. Save. Close.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room while winding down from work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off. Unplug. Put away vacuum. Tidy items. Sit on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Open fridge. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Open oven. Place tray. Set timer. Close oven. Stir pan. Check oven. Turn off induction cooker. Take out tray. Plate food.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up knife. Cut food. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate. Scrape food into bin. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into bin. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close door. Press start. Wipe counter. Wash hands. Dry hands. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch. Adjust volume. Get up. Go to kitchen. Take snack. Return. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Leave room.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking the phone under the desk lamp before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Scroll. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Turn to left side. Remain still.
